_comment: DA-1795 MDS core ingestion configs. POST to /entities/{pilotId}/configs. These 7 keys are what make a pilot MDS. Values below are the CORRECTED set per DA-1795 spec - see 00_README for the 2 keys where pilot 73969 currently drifts from this.

configKVs.configDocumentation: Master MDS enablement flag. When true, ingestion creates stream-specific meters from supported_streams. When false, backend falls back to legacy DELIVERED_AND_RECEIVED behavior.

Core MDS stream-definition JSON. Defines supported stream types per measurement type and the suffix used to build stream-specific tokens and data-stream identifiers. NOTE: SOLAR_GENERATION (suffix SG) is deliberately absent here - add it only if the pilot will ingest an actual generation stream.

Controls whether meter creation and update is handled through meter-enrollment or data-stream flow instead of only user-enrollment flow. Required for MDS onboarding and stream-specific meter creation.
When true, stream activation and deactivation follow stream availability on the user's active rate plan. When false, streams follow enrollment contract dates instead.
Enables rate schedule updates during enrollment and rate transitions. Companion flag for MDS because stream activation and billing behavior must align with active rate-plan schedules.
Legacy update optimization. MDS design guidance is to keep this false because stream-specific meters may need to be created or invalidated independently over time.
Legacy solar-transition behavior for non-MDS pilots. Explicitly not applicable to normal MDS modeling because RECEIVED is expected to be represented as its own stream.
